usedFor: ShipStation holds orders, and HubSpot receives each one as a record through “Create Deal” or “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in ShipStation, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Every new order becomes a deal, and the trigger can be limited to a selected store.

watchOut: “Update Deal” in HubSpot needs a deal ID, so use “Create Deal” for new orders unless you store it.
